449	/// POST /ops/configs/{template_id}/versions/{version_id}/rollout
450	///
451	/// Creates a rollout plan with ordered stages.  The config_version must be
452	/// 'published'.  Stages should cover 100% of depots collectively.
453	pub async fn create_rollout(
454	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
455	    session: AuthSession,
456	    path:    web::Path<(Uuid, Uuid)>,
457	    body:    web::Json<CreateRolloutRequest>,
458	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
459	    session.require(Permission::OpsConfigPublish)?;
460	
461	    let (template_id, version_id) = path.into_inner();
462	
463	    if body.stages.is_empty() {
464	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest("At least one stage is required".to_string()));
465	    }
466	
467	    // Validate stages are in increasing percentage order and depot lists non-empty
468	    let mut last_pct: i16 = 0;
469	    for (i, stage) in body.stages.iter().enumerate() {
470	        if stage.depot_ids.is_empty() {
471	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
472	                "Stage {} has no depot_ids",
473	                i + 1
474	            )));
475	        }
476	        if stage.target_percentage <= last_pct {
477	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
478	                "Stages must have strictly increasing target_percentage values".to_string(),
479	            ));
480	        }
481	        last_pct = stage.target_percentage;
482	    }
483	
484	    // Verify version is published and belongs to the template
485	    let status: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
486	        "SELECT status FROM ops.config_versions WHERE id = $1 AND template_id = $2",
487	    )
488	    .bind(version_id)
489	    .bind(template_id)
490	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
491	    .await?;
492	
493	    match status.as_deref() {
494	        Some("published") => {}
495	        Some(s) => {
496	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
497	                "Config version must be published before creating a rollout (current: {})",
498	                s
499	            )))
500	        }
501	        None => {
502	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
503	                "Config version not found for this template".to_string(),
504	            ))
505	        }
506	    }
507	
508	    let total_depots: i32 = body
509	        .stages
510	        .iter()
511	        .map(|s| s.depot_ids.len() as i32)
512	        .sum();
513	
514	    let mut tx = state.db.begin().await?;
515	
516	    // Create plan
517	    let plan_id: Uuid = sqlx::query_scalar(
518	        r#"
519	        INSERT INTO ops.rollout_plans
520	            (config_version_id, status, total_depots, current_stage, created_by, notes)
521	        VALUES ($1, 'pending', $2, 0, $3, $4)
522	        RETURNING id
523	        "#,
524	    )
525	    .bind(version_id)
526	    .bind(total_depots)
527	    .bind(session.user_id)
528	    .bind(body.notes.as_deref())
529	    .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
530	    .await?;
531	
532	    // Create stages
533	    let mut stage_responses = Vec::new();
534	    for (i, spec) in body.stages.iter().enumerate() {
535	        let stage_number = (i + 1) as i16;
536	        let stage_row = sqlx::query_as::<_, RolloutStageRow>(
537	            r#"
538	            INSERT INTO ops.rollout_stages
539	                (plan_id, stage_number, target_percentage, depot_ids, status, scheduled_at)
540	            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', $5)
541	            RETURNING id, stage_number, target_percentage, depot_ids,
542	                      status, scheduled_at, activated_at
543	            "#,
544	        )
545	        .bind(plan_id)
546	        .bind(stage_number)
547	        .bind(spec.target_percentage)
548	        .bind(&spec.depot_ids)
549	        .bind(spec.scheduled_at)
550	        .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
551	        .await?;
552	
553	        stage_responses.push(RolloutStageResponse {
554	            id:                stage_row.id,
555	            stage_number:      stage_row.stage_number,
556	            target_percentage: stage_row.target_percentage,
557	            depot_count:       stage_row.depot_ids.len(),
558	            status:            stage_row.status,
559	            scheduled_at:      stage_row.scheduled_at,
560	            activated_at:      stage_row.activated_at,
561	        });
562	    }
563	
564	    tx.commit().await?;
565	
566	    tracing::info!(
567	        plan_id    = %plan_id,
568	        version_id = %version_id,
569	        stages     = body.stages.len(),
570	        "Rollout plan created"
571	    );
572	
573	    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(RolloutPlanResponse {
574	        id:                plan_id,
575	        config_version_id: version_id,
576	        status:            "pending".to_string(),
577	        total_depots,
578	        current_stage:     0,
579	        stages:            stage_responses,
580	        created_at:        chrono::Utc::now(),
581	    }))
582	}

584	/// POST /ops/configs/{template_id}/rollout/{plan_id}/stages/{stage_id}/activate
585	///
586	/// Activates a rollout stage:
587	///   1. Marks the stage as 'active'
588	///   2. Upserts depot_config_assignments for every depot in this stage
589	///   3. Advances rollout_plan.current_stage
590	///   4. If all stages complete, marks plan as 'completed'
591	pub async fn activate_rollout_stage(
592	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
593	    session: AuthSession,
594	    path:    web::Path<(Uuid, Uuid, Uuid)>,
595	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
596	    session.require(Permission::OpsConfigPublish)?;
597	
598	    let (template_id, plan_id, stage_id) = path.into_inner();
599	
600	    // Load stage (validates plan ownership)
601	    let stage = sqlx::query_as::<_, RolloutStageRow>(
602	        r#"
603	        SELECT rs.id, rs.stage_number, rs.target_percentage,
604	               rs.depot_ids, rs.status, rs.scheduled_at, rs.activated_at
605	        FROM   ops.rollout_stages rs
606	        JOIN   ops.rollout_plans  rp ON rp.id = rs.plan_id
607	        WHERE  rs.id = $1 AND rs.plan_id = $2 AND rp.config_version_id IN (
608	            SELECT id FROM ops.config_versions WHERE template_id = $3
609	        )
610	        "#,
611	    )
612	    .bind(stage_id)
613	    .bind(plan_id)
614	    .bind(template_id)
615	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
616	    .await?
617	    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Stage not found for this plan/template".to_string()))?;
618	
619	    if stage.status != "pending" {
620	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
621	            "Stage is already {}",
622	            stage.status
623	        )));
624	    }
625	
626	    // Load config_version_id from the plan
627	    let (config_version_id, previous_stage): (Uuid, i32) = sqlx::query_as(
628	        "SELECT config_version_id, current_stage FROM ops.rollout_plans WHERE id = $1",
629	    )
630	    .bind(plan_id)
631	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
632	    .await?;
633	
634	    // Enforce sequential stage activation
635	    if stage.stage_number as i32 != previous_stage + 1 {
636	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
637	            "Must activate stage {} before stage {}",
638	            previous_stage + 1,
639	            stage.stage_number
640	        )));
641	    }
642	
643	    let mut tx = state.db.begin().await?;
644	
645	    // Activate stage
646	    sqlx::query(
647	        r#"
648	        UPDATE ops.rollout_stages
649	        SET    status       = 'active',
650	               activated_at = now(),
651	               activated_by = $2,
652	               updated_at   = now()
653	        WHERE  id = $1
654	        "#,
655	    )
656	    .bind(stage_id)
657	    .bind(session.user_id)
658	    .execute(&mut *tx)
659	    .await?;
660	
661	    // Upsert depot_config_assignments for every depot in this stage
662	    for depot_id in &stage.depot_ids {
663	        sqlx::query(
664	            r#"
665	            INSERT INTO ops.depot_config_assignments
666	                (depot_id, template_id, config_version_id, rollout_stage_id, assigned_by)
667	            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
668	            ON CONFLICT (depot_id, template_id) DO UPDATE
669	                SET config_version_id = EXCLUDED.config_version_id,
670	                    rollout_stage_id  = EXCLUDED.rollout_stage_id,
671	                    assigned_at       = now(),
672	                    assigned_by       = EXCLUDED.assigned_by
673	            "#,
674	        )
675	        .bind(depot_id)
676	        .bind(template_id)
677	        .bind(config_version_id)
678	        .bind(stage_id)
679	        .bind(session.user_id)
680	        .execute(&mut *tx)
681	        .await?;
682	    }
683	
684	    // Advance plan counter; check if all stages are now active → mark plan completed
685	    let total_stages: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
686	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops.rollout_stages WHERE plan_id = $1",
687	    )
688	    .bind(plan_id)
689	    .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
690	    .await?;
691	
692	    let new_stage = previous_stage + 1;
693	    let plan_status = if new_stage as i64 == total_stages {
694	        // Mark all stages completed
695	        sqlx::query(
696	            "UPDATE ops.rollout_stages SET status = 'completed', updated_at = now() WHERE plan_id = $1 AND status = 'active'",
697	        )
698	        .bind(plan_id)
699	        .execute(&mut *tx)
700	        .await?;
701	        "completed"
702	    } else {
703	        "active"
704	    };
705	
706	    sqlx::query(
707	        r#"
708	        UPDATE ops.rollout_plans
709	        SET    current_stage = $2, status = $3, updated_at = now()
710	        WHERE  id = $1
711	        "#,
712	    )
713	    .bind(plan_id)
714	    .bind(new_stage)
715	    .bind(plan_status)
716	    .execute(&mut *tx)
717	    .await?;
718	
719	    tx.commit().await?;
720	
721	    tracing::info!(
722	        plan_id      = %plan_id,
723	        stage_id     = %stage_id,
724	        stage_number = %stage.stage_number,
725	        depot_count  = stage.depot_ids.len(),
726	        "Rollout stage activated"
727	    );
728	
729	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(serde_json::json!({
730	        "message":       "Stage activated",
731	        "stage_number":  stage.stage_number,
732	        "depots_updated": stage.depot_ids.len(),
733	        "plan_status":   plan_status
734	    })))
735	}

23	/// POST /reconciliation/statements
24	///
25	/// Upload a daily bank/provider statement CSV for a given date.
26	///
27	/// Body (JSON):
28	/// ```json
29	/// {
30	///   "filename":            "alipay_2025-01-15.csv",
31	///   "source":              "alipay",
32	///   "content_base64":      "<base64-encoded CSV>",
33	///   "expected_fingerprint": "<sha256-hex>"   // optional
34	/// }
35	/// ```
36	///
37	/// Steps:
38	///   1. Decode base64 content.
39	///   2. Compute SHA-256 fingerprint.
40	///   3. If `expected_fingerprint` provided, verify it matches (reject on mismatch).
41	///   4. Detect duplicate file (same hash previously imported).
42	///   5. Validate CSV format strictly.
43	///   6. Store in `statement_imports` with validation metadata.
44	///
45	/// Returns 400 if the fingerprint doesn't match or the file was already imported.
46	/// Returns the import record regardless of format errors — callers can inspect
47	/// `errors` and decide whether to trigger reconciliation.
48	#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
49	pub struct UploadStatementRequest {
50	    pub filename:             String,
51	    pub source:               String,
52	    pub content_base64:       String,
53	    pub expected_fingerprint: Option<String>,
54	}
55	
56	pub async fn upload_statement(
57	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
58	    session: AuthSession,
59	    body:    web::Json<UploadStatementRequest>,
60	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
61	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsStatementsImport)?;
62	
63	    // ---- Decode ----
64	    let content = B64.decode(&body.content_base64).map_err(|e| {
65	        AppError::BadRequest(format!("content_base64 is not valid base64: {}", e))
66	    })?;
67	
68	    // ---- Fingerprint ----
69	    let actual_fp = importer::fingerprint(&content);
70	
71	    if let Some(ref expected) = body.expected_fingerprint {
72	        if !importer::verify_fingerprint(&content, expected) {
73	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
74	                "Fingerprint mismatch — expected {}, got {}",
75	                expected, actual_fp
76	            )));
77	        }
78	    }
79	
80	    // ---- Duplicate file check ----
81	    let existing_id: Option<Uuid> = sqlx::query_scalar!(
82	        "SELECT id FROM payments.statement_imports WHERE file_hash = $1",
83	        actual_fp,
84	    )
85	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
86	    .await?;
87	
88	    if let Some(eid) = existing_id {
89	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
90	            "File already imported — existing import_id: {}", eid
91	        )));
92	    }
93	
94	    // ---- Format validation ----
95	    let parse = importer::validate_and_parse(&content);
96	
97	    let format_errors_json = serde_json::to_value(&parse.errors).unwrap_or(serde_json::json!([]));
98	
99	    // ---- Persist import record ----
100	    let import_date = Utc::now().date_naive();
101	    let import_id: Uuid = sqlx::query_scalar!(
102	        r#"
103	        INSERT INTO payments.statement_imports
104	            (filename, file_hash, source, import_date, imported_by,
105	             raw_content_encrypted, format_errors, fingerprint_expected)
106	        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
107	        RETURNING id
108	        "#,
109	        body.filename,
110	        actual_fp,
111	        body.source,
112	        import_date,
113	        session.user_id,
114	        content.as_slice(),
115	        format_errors_json,
116	        body.expected_fingerprint.as_deref(),
117	    )
118	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
119	    .await?;
120	
121	    // ---- Persist parsed lines (only when valid) ----
122	    if parse.is_valid {
123	        for (line_no, rec) in parse.records.iter().enumerate() {
124	            sqlx::query!(
125	                r#"
126	                INSERT INTO payments.statement_import_lines
127	                    (import_id, line_number, transaction_ref, amount,
128	                     transaction_date, description, match_status)
129	                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'unmatched')
130	                "#,
131	                import_id,
132	                (line_no + 1) as i32,
133	                rec.reference.as_str(),
134	                rec.amount,
135	                rec.date,
136	                rec.description.as_deref(),
137	            )
138	            .execute(&state.db)
139	            .await?;
140	        }
141	
142	        // Mark duplicates
143	        tag_duplicate_lines(&state.db, import_id, &parse.records).await?;
144	    }
145	
146	    // Update status
147	    let status = if parse.is_valid { "completed" } else { "failed" };
148	    sqlx::query!(
149	        r#"UPDATE payments.statement_imports
150	           SET status = $2, total_records = $3, processed_records = $3, updated_at = now()
151	           WHERE id = $1"#,
152	        import_id,
153	        status,
154	        parse.records.len() as i32,
155	    )
156	    .execute(&state.db)
157	    .await?;
158	
159	    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(UploadResponse {
160	        import_id,
161	        fingerprint:  actual_fp,
162	        record_count: parse.records.len(),
163	        is_valid:     parse.is_valid,
164	        errors:       parse.errors,
165	    }))
166	}

168	/// Tag duplicate lines in `statement_import_lines` after initial insert.
169	async fn tag_duplicate_lines(
170	    pool:      &sqlx::PgPool,
171	    import_id: Uuid,
172	    records:   &[super::models::StatementRecord],
173	) -> Result<(), AppError> {
174	    use super::discrepancy::{canonical_index, find_duplicates};
175	
176	    let dup_map = find_duplicates(records);
177	    if dup_map.is_empty() { return Ok(()); }
178	
179	    // For each duplicate group: look up line IDs by line_number, then set
180	    // duplicate_of_line_id on non-canonical rows.
181	    for (_ref, indices) in &dup_map {
182	        let canonical_line_no = (canonical_index(indices) + 1) as i32;
183	
184	        // Get the canonical line's ID
185	        let canonical_id: Option<Uuid> = sqlx::query_scalar!(
186	            "SELECT id FROM payments.statement_import_lines WHERE import_id = $1 AND line_number = $2",
187	            import_id,
188	            canonical_line_no,
189	        )
190	        .fetch_optional(pool)
191	        .await
192	        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
193	
194	        let Some(cid) = canonical_id else { continue };
195	
196	        // Tag all non-canonical lines in this group
197	        for &idx in indices {
198	            let line_no = (idx + 1) as i32;
199	            if line_no == canonical_line_no { continue; }
200	
201	            sqlx::query!(
202	                r#"UPDATE payments.statement_import_lines
203	                   SET duplicate_of_line_id = $3
204	                   WHERE import_id = $1 AND line_number = $2"#,
205	                import_id,
206	                line_no,
207	                cid,
208	            )
209	            .execute(pool)
210	            .await
211	            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
212	        }
213	    }
214	
215	    Ok(())
216	}

222	/// POST /reconciliation/runs
223	///
224	/// Start a reconciliation run against a previously uploaded statement.
225	/// Idempotent: if a run already exists for `run_date`, it is re-executed
226	/// and its results overwritten.
227	pub async fn start_run(
228	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
229	    session: AuthSession,
230	    body:    web::Json<StartRunRequest>,
231	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
232	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsReconciliationRun)?;
233	
234	    // ---- Verify the import exists and is in a usable state ----
235	    let import = sqlx::query!(
236	        "SELECT status, file_hash, raw_content_encrypted FROM payments.statement_imports WHERE id = $1",
237	        body.statement_import_id,
238	    )
239	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
240	    .await?
241	    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Statement import not found".to_string()))?;
242	
243	    if import.status == "failed" {
244	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
245	            "Cannot reconcile: the statement import failed format validation".to_string(),
246	        ));
247	    }
248	
249	    // ---- Optional fingerprint re-verification ----
250	    if let Some(ref expected) = body.expected_fingerprint {
251	        if &import.file_hash != expected {
252	            return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
253	                "Fingerprint mismatch — file hash is {}, expected {}",
254	                import.file_hash, expected
255	            )));
256	        }
257	    }
258	
259	    // ---- Re-parse the stored content ----
260	    let raw = import.raw_content_encrypted
261	        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Import has no stored content".to_string()))?;
262	
263	    let parse = importer::validate_and_parse(&raw);
264	    if !parse.is_valid {
265	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
266	            "Statement has {} format error(s): {}",
267	            parse.errors.len(),
268	            parse.errors.join("; ")
269	        )));
270	    }
271	
272	    // ---- Run the engine ----
273	    let output = engine::run(
274	        &state.db,
275	        body.run_date,
276	        body.statement_import_id,
277	        &parse.records,
278	        session.user_id,
279	    )
280	    .await?;
281	
282	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(serde_json::json!({
283	        "run_id":              output.run_id,
284	        "run_date":            output.run_date,
285	        "matched":             output.matched,
286	        "amount_mismatches":   output.amount_mismatches,
287	        "missing_from_statement": output.missing_from_stmt,
288	        "extra_in_statement":  output.extra_in_stmt,
289	        "duplicates":          output.duplicates,
290	        "discrepancy_count":   output.discrepancy_count(),
291	        "total_expected":      output.total_expected,
292	        "total_collected":     output.total_collected,
293	        "total_discrepancy":   output.total_collected - output.total_expected,
294	        "is_high_discrepancy": output.is_high_discrepancy(output.items.len()),
295	    })))
296	}

8	        middleware::{hash_token, AuthSession},
9	        models::{
10	            LoginRequest, LoginResponse, LogoutResponse, ReauthRequest, ReauthResponse,
11	            SessionResponse, UserRow,

19	// ============================================================
20	// POST /auth/login
21	// ============================================================
22	//
23	// Flow:
24	//  1. Load user row (returns same error for unknown user or wrong password
25	//     to prevent user enumeration)
26	//  2. Check account lockout
27	//  3. Verify password with argon2id (inherently ~100 ms — natural brute-force delay)
28	//  4. On failure: increment failed_attempts; lock account after threshold is reached
29	//  5. On success: reset failed_attempts, create session, return raw token
30	// ============================================================
31	
32	pub async fn login(
33	    state: web::Data<AppState>,
34	    req: HttpRequest,
35	    body: web::Json<LoginRequest>,
36	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
37	    let ip = req
38	        .connection_info()
39	        .realip_remote_addr()
40	        .map(str::to_string);
41	    let user_agent = req
42	        .headers()
43	        .get("User-Agent")
44	        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
45	        .map(str::to_string);
46	
47	    // --- 1. Fetch user (constant-error on not-found prevents enumeration) ---
48	    let user = sqlx::query_as::<_, UserRow>(
49	        r#"
50	        SELECT u.id,
51	               u.username,
52	               u.password_hash,
53	               u.is_active,
54	               u.failed_login_attempts,
55	               u.locked_until,
56	               r.name AS role_name
57	        FROM   auth.users u
58	        JOIN   auth.roles r ON r.id = u.role_id
59	        WHERE  u.username  = $1
60	          AND  u.deleted_at IS NULL
61	        "#,
62	    )
63	    .bind(&body.username)
64	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
65	    .await?;
66	
67	    // Treat "user not found" identically to "wrong password" at the HTTP layer.
68	    let user = match user {
69	        Some(u) => u,
70	        None    => return Err(AppError::Unauthorized("Invalid credentials".to_string())),
71	    };
72	
73	    // --- 2. Lockout check ---
74	    if let Some(locked_until) = user.locked_until {
75	        if locked_until > Utc::now() {
76	            return Err(AppError::AccountLocked(locked_until.to_rfc3339()));
77	        }
78	    }
79	
80	    if !user.is_active {
81	        return Err(AppError::Unauthorized("Account is inactive".to_string()));
82	    }
83	
84	    // --- 3. Verify password (argon2id; constant-time comparison inside crate) ---
85	    let valid = verify_password(&body.password, &user.password_hash)?;
86	
87	    if !valid {
88	        // --- 4. Record failed attempt + conditional lock ---
89	        record_failed_attempt(&state, user.id).await?;
90	        return Err(AppError::Unauthorized("Invalid credentials".to_string()));
91	    }
92	
93	    // --- 5a. Reset failure counters on successful authentication ---
94	    sqlx::query(
95	        r#"
96	        UPDATE auth.users
97	        SET    failed_login_attempts = 0,
98	               locked_until          = NULL,
99	               last_login_at         = now(),
100	               updated_at            = now()
101	        WHERE  id = $1
102	        "#,
103	    )
104	    .bind(user.id)
105	    .execute(&state.db)
106	    .await?;
107	
108	    // --- 5b. Create session ---
109	    let raw_token  = generate_session_token();
110	    let token_hash = hash_token(&raw_token);
111	    let session_id = Uuid::new_v4();
112	    let expires_at = Utc::now() + Duration::hours(state.config.session_max_age_hours);
113	
114	    sqlx::query(
115	        r#"
116	        INSERT INTO auth.sessions
117	            (id, user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at,
118	             last_activity_at, ip_address, user_agent)
119	        VALUES
120	            ($1, $2, $3, now(), $4, now(), $5::inet, $6)

176	pub async fn get_session(
177	    state: web::Data<AppState>,
178	    session: AuthSession,
179	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
180	    let reauth_required = match session.last_reauth_at {
181	        Some(t) => Utc::now() - t > Duration::minutes(state.config.reauth_window_minutes),
182	        None    => true,
183	    };
184	
185	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(SessionResponse {
186	        session_id:       session.session_id,
187	        user_id:          session.user_id,
188	        username:         session.username,
189	        role:             session.role,
190	        expires_at:       session.expires_at,
191	        last_activity_at: session.last_activity_at,
192	        reauth_required,
193	    }))
194	}

196	// ============================================================
197	// POST /auth/reauth
198	// ============================================================
199	//
200	// The user is already authenticated (AuthSession extractor runs first).
201	// We verify their password again and stamp last_reauth_at on the session.
202	// This satisfies the ReauthGuard check for subsequent admin-action calls.
203	// ============================================================
204	
205	pub async fn reauth(
206	    state: web::Data<AppState>,
207	    session: AuthSession,
208	    body: web::Json<ReauthRequest>,
209	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
210	    // Fetch the current password hash for this user.
211	    let password_hash: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
212	        "SELECT password_hash FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL",
213	    )
214	    .bind(session.user_id)
215	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
216	    .await?;
217	
218	    let password_hash = password_hash
219	        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::Unauthorized("User not found".to_string()))?;
220	
221	    let valid = verify_password(&body.password, &password_hash)?;
222	    if !valid {
223	        return Err(AppError::Unauthorized("Invalid credentials".to_string()));
224	    }
225	
226	    let now = Utc::now();
227	    sqlx::query("UPDATE auth.sessions SET last_reauth_at = $1 WHERE id = $2")
228	        .bind(now)
229	        .bind(session.session_id)
230	        .execute(&state.db)
231	        .await?;
232	
233	    tracing::info!(user_id = %session.user_id, "Re-authentication successful");
234	
235	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(ReauthResponse {
236	        message:   "Re-authenticated successfully",
237	        reauth_at: now,
238	    }))
239	}

## COMPREHENSIVE REPORT: Sensitive Data Protection Implementation Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the Rust/Actix-web codebase, here are the specific findings for your data protection implementation:

---

### 1. SENSITIVE FIELDS IN DB SCHEMAS (Exact table.column names)

**AUTH SCHEMA - User PII:**
- `auth.users.email_encrypted` (BYTEA) - pgp_sym_encrypt of email
- `auth.users.full_name_encrypted` (BYTEA) - pgp_sym_encrypt of full name
- `auth.users.password_hash` (TEXT) - Argon2id hash
- `auth.sessions.token_hash` (TEXT) - SHA-256 of raw JWT token
- `auth.sessions.ip_address` (INET) - user session IP
- `auth.sessions.user_agent` (TEXT) - user session browser/client info

**PAYMENTS SCHEMA - Card/Payment Data:**
- `payments.transactions.card_last4_encrypted` (BYTEA) - pgp_sym_encrypt of last 4 card digits
- `payments.transactions.payer_ref_encrypted` (BYTEA) - pgp_sym_encrypt of external payer ID
- `payments.statement_imports.raw_content_encrypted` (BYTEA) - pgp_sym_encrypt of bank statement file bytes
- `payments.transactions.metadata` (JSONB) - arbitrary payment metadata (can contain sensitive provider IDs)

**NOTIFICATIONS SCHEMA - Contact Details:**
- `notifications.subscriptions.channel` (VARCHAR) - email/sms/inbox/wecom channels
- `notifications.deliveries.channel` (VARCHAR) - delivery channel type
- No explicit phone/email columns stored (encrypted elsewhere or in audit logs)

**AUDIT SCHEMA - Sensitive Activity Logs:**
- `audit.audit_logs.ip_address` (INET) - user action source IP
- `audit.audit_logs.user_agent` (TEXT) - user action client info
- `audit.audit_logs.before_state` (JSONB) - previous state before updates (can contain PII)
- `audit.audit_logs.after_state` (JSONB) - new state after updates (can contain PII)
- `audit.audit_logs.diff` (JSONB) - computed differences (can expose sensitive field changes)

---

### 2. CONFIG SYSTEM (src/config.rs)

**Config struct fields:**
```rust
pub struct Config {
    pub database_url:     String,
    pub server_host:      String,
    pub server_port:      u16,
    pub encryption_key:   String,
    pub lockout_threshold: i32,
    pub lockout_duration_minutes: i64,
    pub inactivity_timeout_minutes: i64,
    pub reauth_window_minutes: i64,
    pub session_max_age_hours: i64,
}
```

**Load mechanism:** `from_env()` loads from environment variables:
- `DATABASE_URL` (required)
- `SERVER_HOST` (defaults to 127.0.0.1)
- `SERVER_PORT` (defaults to 8080)
- `ENCRYPTION_KEY` (required) - used for pgp_sym_encrypt/decrypt at application layer
- Auth constants have hardcoded defaults (lockout=5 attempts, 15min duration, 30min inactivity timeout, 10min reauth window, 8hr max session)

---

### 3. FULL CARGO.TOML DEPENDENCIES

```toml
[dependencies]
actix-web = "4"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
sqlx = { version = "0.7", features = ["runtime-tokio-rustls", "postgres", "uuid", "chrono", "macros"] }
argon2 = { version = "0.5", features = ["std"] }
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
rand = "0.8"
sha2 = "0.10"
hex = "0.4"
thiserror = "1"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
dotenvy = "0.15"
futures-util = "0.3"
csv = "1"
printpdf = "0.7"
hmac = "0.12"
base64 = "0.22"
```

**Crypto-related dependencies:**
- `argon2` (password hashing)
- `sha2` (SHA-256 for token hashing and signatures)
- `hmac` (HMAC signature verification for payment callbacks)
- **NOTE:** No AES/ChaCha crypto library in Rust code itself. Encryption relies on PostgreSQL's `pgcrypto` extension (PGP symmetric encryption at database level, key supplied from `ENCRYPTION_KEY` env var at query time).

---

### 4. PAYMENT RESPONSE TYPES & SERIALIZED FIELDS

**`TransactionResponse` (src/payments/models.rs, lines 184-197):**
- `id` (Uuid)
- `idempotency_key` (String)
- `trip_id` (Option<Uuid>)
- `route_id` (Option<Uuid>)
- `amount` (f64)
- `currency` (String)
- `payment_method` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `metadata` (serde_json::Value) - **Can contain sensitive provider data**
- `created_at`, `updated_at` (DateTime<Utc>)

**NOTE:** `card_last4_encrypted` and `payer_ref_encrypted` are NOT included in API responses (they remain encrypted in DB and are never deserialized to the client).

**`CallbackResponse` (lines 217-227):**
- `id`, `transaction_id`, `source`, `status`, `nonce`, `callback_timestamp`, `received_at`, `processed_at`
- Does NOT expose raw payload or signature

**`RefundResponse` (lines 244-256):**
- `id`, `transaction_id`, `idempotency_key`, `amount`, `reason`, `status`, `requested_by`, `approved_by`, `processed_at`, `created_at`

**`StatementImportResponse` (lines 275-287):**
- `id`, `filename`, `source`, `import_date`, `status`, `total_records`, `processed_records`, `error_count`, `imported_by`, `created_at`
- **NOTE:** `raw_content_encrypted` is NOT serialized to API responses (remains encrypted in DB)

---

### 5. AUTH RESPONSE TYPES & SERIALIZED FIELDS

**`LoginResponse` (src/auth/models.rs, lines 24-32):**
- `token` (String) - Raw session token (client stores and sends as Bearer)
- `expires_at` (DateTime<Utc>)
- `user_id` (Uuid)
- `username` (String)
- `role` (String)

**`SessionResponse` (lines 34-45):**
- `session_id` (Uuid)
- `user_id` (Uuid)
- `username` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `expires_at` (DateTime<Utc>)
- `last_activity_at` (DateTime<Utc>)
- `reauth_required` (bool)

**`UserRow` (Internal, lines 63-72, NOT serialized):**
- `id`, `username`, `password_hash`, `role_name`, `is_active`, `failed_login_attempts`, `locked_until`

**`SessionRow` (Internal, lines 75-85, NOT serialized):**
- `id`, `user_id`, `expires_at`, `revoked_at`, `last_activity_at`, `last_reauth_at`, `username`, `role_name`

**NOTE:** `email_encrypted` and `full_name_encrypted` are NEVER included in any API response (they remain encrypted in DB and only decrypted server-side when needed for internal operations).

---

### 6. NOTIFICATIONS - CONTACT DETAILS

**`DeliveryResponse` (src/notifications/models.rs, lines 113-125):**
- `id`, `event_id`, `event_type`, `severity`, `source_entity_id`, `payload`, `status`, `delivered_at`, `read_at`, `created_at`
- **No explicit phone/email fields** stored in response

**`PreferencesResponse` (lines 133-139):**
- `dnd_enabled` (bool)
- `dnd_start`, `dnd_end` (Option<NaiveTime>) - Do-Not-Disturb window times
- `updated_at` (DateTime<Utc>)

**Database Storage:**
- `notifications.subscriptions.channel` (inbox/email/sms/wecom) - **No actual email/phone stored, only channel type**
- Contact details for notification delivery are NOT stored in notification tables (assumed handled by external provider or separate encrypted channel)

---

### 7. PAYMENT TABLES - DETAILED FIELD SCAN

**payments.transactions:**
- `card_last4_encrypted` (BYTEA) - **encrypted**
- `payer_ref_encrypted` (BYTEA) - **encrypted**
- `metadata` (JSONB) - **unencrypted, may contain sensitive data**

**payments.callbacks:**
- `payload` (JSONB) - raw provider payload (may contain sensitive provider refs)
- `signature` (TEXT) - provider signature
- `payload_hash` (TEXT) - SHA-256 hash for replay prevention

**payments.refunds:**
- No encrypted payment fields (amount only, not card data)

**payments.statement_imports:**
- `raw_content_encrypted` (BYTEA) - **encrypted bank statement file content**
- `filename` (VARCHAR) - **unencrypted filename**

**payments.reconciliation_runs & items:**
- No card/payment method sensitive data (only amounts and reconciliation status)

---

### 8. KEY OBSERVATIONS FOR DATA PROTECTION STRATEGY

1. **Encryption At-Rest Strategy:** Uses PostgreSQL `pgcrypto` extension for symmetric encryption (not Rust-native crypto). Encryption key supplied via `ENCRYPTION_KEY` env var.

2. **In-Transit Protection:** Uses HMAC (sha2 + hmac crate) for payment gateway callback signature verification. Tokens are hashed (SHA-256) before storage.

3. **Sensitive Fields NOT In API Responses:**
   - `card_last4_encrypted`, `payer_ref_encrypted` (locked in payments schema)
   - `email_encrypted`, `full_name_encrypted` (locked in auth schema)
   - `raw_content_encrypted` (locked in statement imports)
   - `token_hash`, `password_hash` (never serialized)

4. **Audit Trail Exposure Risk:** `audit.audit_logs.before_state` and `after_state` (JSONB) can capture entire encrypted/unencrypted records during updates - these JSONB fields should be masked or excluded in sensitive entity audits.

5. **Metadata JSONB Fields:** Payment `metadata` field is unencrypted in DB and fully serialized to API responses - ensure no sensitive provider IDs or card tokens are placed here.

6. **No Built-In Application Encryption:** Rust code does NOT use AES/ChaCha libraries. All sensitive encryption delegated to PostgreSQL at DB layer via application-supplied ENCRYPTION_KEY.

- Auth models & handlers: `/src/auth/models.rs`, `/src/auth/handlers.rs`
- Notifications: `/src/notifications/models.rs`

26	/// POST /payments/transactions
27	///
28	/// Idempotent: if `idempotency_key` already exists returns the existing record
29	/// with `200 OK` rather than `201 Created`.
30	pub async fn create_transaction(
31	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
32	    session: AuthSession,
33	    body:    web::Json<CreateTransactionRequest>,
34	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
35	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsTransactionsWrite)?;
36	
37	    // Idempotency check
38	    let existing = sqlx::query_as!(
39	        TransactionRow,
40	        r#"
41	        SELECT id, idempotency_key, trip_id, route_id,
42	               amount::double precision, currency, payment_method, status,
43	               collected_by, metadata, created_at, updated_at
44	        FROM payments.transactions
45	        WHERE idempotency_key = $1
46	        "#,
47	        body.idempotency_key,
48	    )
49	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
50	    .await?;
51	
52	    if let Some(row) = existing {
53	        return Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(TransactionResponse::from(row)));
54	    }
55	
56	    let valid_methods = ["cash","card","mobile","bank_transfer","voucher","other"];
57	    if !valid_methods.contains(&body.payment_method.as_str()) {
58	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
59	            "payment_method must be one of: {}", valid_methods.join(", ")
60	        )));
61	    }
62	
63	    let currency = body.currency.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "CNY".to_string());
64	    let metadata = body.metadata.clone().unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Object(Default::default()));
65	
66	    let row = sqlx::query_as!(
67	        TransactionRow,
68	        r#"
69	        INSERT INTO payments.transactions
70	            (idempotency_key, trip_id, route_id, amount, currency,
71	             payment_method, collected_by, metadata)
72	        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
73	        RETURNING id, idempotency_key, trip_id, route_id,
74	                  amount::double precision, currency, payment_method, status,
75	                  collected_by, metadata, created_at, updated_at
76	        "#,
77	        body.idempotency_key,
78	        body.trip_id,
79	        body.route_id,
80	        body.amount,
81	        currency,
82	        body.payment_method,
83	        session.user_id,
84	        metadata,
85	    )
86	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
87	    .await?;
88	
89	    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(TransactionResponse::from(row)))
90	}

Now I have a complete picture. Let me compile my final report with all the essential information:

## Complete Notification System Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here is the complete picture of the existing notification system:

### **1. CORE EVENT BUS IMPLEMENTATION** (`src/notifications/bus.rs`)

**Poll Loop**: Every 5 seconds, runs three operations:
1. `process_pending_events()` - Fan-out up to 50 pending events to subscribers
2. `evaluate_periodic_rules()` - Threshold and spike rule evaluation  
3. `flush_dnd_queue()` - Promote queued deliveries when DND windows close

**Event Dispatch Logic**:
- Queries `notifications.events` where `processed_at IS NULL`
- Resolves effective severity: `COALESCE(payload->>'severity', event_definitions.severity, 'info')`
- Calls `fan_out_event()` to deliver to subscribers
- Marks event `processed_at = now()` after processing
- **DND Handling**: Non-critical deliveries insert with `status = 'queued'` if user is in DND window; critical events bypass DND
- **Deduplication**: Skips delivery if same `(user_id, event_type, source_entity_id)` was delivered/queued within 15 minutes

**Recipient Resolution**:
- For `sys.announcement` events: Reads `payload->target_roles` (array); fans out to all active users or specified roles
- For regular events: Queries `notifications.subscriptions WHERE event_type = $1`

---

### **2. DATABASE SCHEMA (Current + Applied Migrations)**

**`notifications.event_definitions`** (base schema.sql):
```
id           UUID PRIMARY KEY
event_type   VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE
domain       VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
description  TEXT
payload_schema JSONB
created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
severity     TEXT DEFAULT 'info' (ADDED in 004) — CHECK: 'info'|'warning'|'critical'
```

**`notifications.events`** (base schema.sql + 004):
```
id               UUID PRIMARY KEY
event_type       VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES event_definitions(event_type)
source_domain    VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
source_entity_id UUID (optional)
actor_id         UUID (optional) — who triggered; null for system events
payload          JSONB DEFAULT '{}'
created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
severity         TEXT DEFAULT 'info' (ADDED in 004) — CHECK: 'info'|'warning'|'critical'
processed_at     TIMESTAMPTZ (ADDED in 004) — NULL means pending fan-out
```

**Indexes**:
- `idx_events_event_type(event_type)`
- `idx_events_created_at(created_at DESC)`
- `idx_events_entity(source_domain, source_entity_id)`
- `idx_events_pending(created_at ASC) WHERE processed_at IS NULL` (004)

**`notifications.preferences`** (ADDED in 004, modified in 005):
```
user_id      UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
dnd_enabled  BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE (updated in 005)
dnd_start    TIME DEFAULT '22:00:00' (updated in 005)
dnd_end      TIME DEFAULT '07:00:00' (updated in 005)
updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
```
Notes: NULL `dnd_start`/`dnd_end` + `dnd_enabled=TRUE` = all-day DND. Crosses midnight logic: if `start <= end`, check `now() BETWEEN start AND end`; if `start > end`, check `now() >= start OR now() <= end`

**`notifications.subscriptions`** (ADDED in 004, simplified):
```
id           UUID PRIMARY KEY
user_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
event_type   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_definitions(event_type) ON DELETE CASCADE
created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE(user_id, event_type)
```

**Index**: `idx_subscriptions_event_type(event_type)`

**`notifications.deliveries`** (ADDED in 004, modified in 005):
```
id           UUID PRIMARY KEY
event_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
user_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
status       TEXT DEFAULT 'delivered' (005 changes to support 'queued')
             CHECK: 'delivered'|'read'|'dismissed'|'queued' (004→005)
delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() (005: made nullable for queued rows)
read_at      TIMESTAMPTZ (optional)
created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE(event_id, user_id) — idempotent bus inserts
```

**Indexes**:
- `idx_deliveries_user_unread(user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE status = 'delivered'` (004)
- `idx_deliveries_queued(user_id) WHERE status = 'queued'` (005)

**`notifications.subscription_rules`** (ADDED in 005):
```
id                UUID PRIMARY KEY
user_id           UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
rule_name         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(trim(rule_name)) > 0)
rule_type         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK: 'keyword'|'topic'|'entity_threshold'|'spike'
is_enabled        BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE
config            JSONB DEFAULT '{}' — type-specific config
severity_override TEXT CHECK: 'info'|'warning'|'critical' (optional)
cooldown_minutes  INT DEFAULT 15 CHECK: >= 1
last_triggered_at TIMESTAMPTZ (optional, set when rule fires)
created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
```

**Indexes**:
- `idx_subscription_rules_user(user_id)`
- `idx_subscription_rules_active_type(rule_type) WHERE is_enabled = TRUE`

---

### **3. MODELS** (`src/notifications/models.rs`)

**Database Row Types**:
- `PendingEventRow`: id, event_type, source_entity_id, actor_id, payload, effective_severity
- `DeliveryRow`: id, event_id, event_type, severity, source_entity_id, payload, status, delivered_at, read_at, created_at
- `PreferencesRow`: dnd_enabled, dnd_start, dnd_end, updated_at
- `EventDefRow`: event_type, description, severity
- `SubscriptionRuleRow`: id, user_id, rule_name, rule_type, is_enabled, config, severity_override, cooldown_minutes, last_triggered_at, created_at, updated_at

**Request Bodies**:
- `DeliveryQuery`: status (unread|read|dismissed|queued|all), limit, offset
- `UpdatePreferencesRequest`: dnd_enabled, dnd_start (optional), dnd_end (optional)
- `UpdateSubscriptionsRequest`: event_types: Vec<String>
- `AnnounceRequest`: title, message, severity (optional), target_roles (optional)
- `ReceiptRequest`: delivery_ids: Vec<Uuid>
- `CreateRuleRequest`: rule_name, rule_type, config, severity_override (optional), cooldown_minutes (optional)
- `UpdateRuleRequest`: rule_name, config, severity_override, cooldown_minutes (all optional)

**Response Types**:
- `DeliveryResponse`: id, event_id, event_type, severity, source_entity_id, payload, status, delivered_at, read_at, created_at
- `UnreadCountResponse`: unread (i64), queued (i64)
- `PreferencesResponse`: dnd_enabled, dnd_start, dnd_end, updated_at
- `SubscriptionInfo`: event_type, description, severity, subscribed (bool)
- `SubscriptionRuleResponse`: id, rule_name, rule_type, is_enabled, config, severity_override, cooldown_minutes, last_triggered_at, created_at, updated_at

---

### **4. HANDLER ROUTES** (`src/notifications/handlers.rs`)

**Inbox**:
- `GET /notifications` → `list_deliveries` — Query params: status, limit, offset
- `GET /notifications/unread-count` → `unread_count` — Returns {unread, queued}
- `GET /notifications/{id}` → `get_notification` — Single delivery detail
- `POST /notifications/{id}/read` → `mark_read`
- `POST /notifications/read-all` → `read_all`
- `POST /notifications/{id}/dismiss` → `dismiss`

**DND Preferences**:
- `GET /notifications/preferences` → `get_preferences`
- `PUT /notifications/preferences` → `update_preferences`

**Event-Type Subscriptions**:
- `GET /notifications/subscriptions` → `list_subscriptions` — Returns all event types + user's opt-ins
- `PUT /notifications/subscriptions` → `update_subscriptions` — Bulk replace

**Subscription Rules**:
- `GET /notifications/rules` → `list_rules`
- `POST /notifications/rules` → `create_rule`
- `GET /notifications/rules/{id}` → `get_rule`
- `PUT /notifications/rules/{id}` → `update_rule` (partial)
- `DELETE /notifications/rules/{id}` → `delete_rule`
- `POST /notifications/rules/{id}/toggle` → `toggle_rule` (flip is_enabled)

**Announcements**:
- `POST /notifications/announce` → `announce` (ops_admin only)

**Delivery Receipts**:
- `POST /notifications/receipt` → `receipt` — Promotes queued→delivered for visible items

---

### **5. SUBSCRIPTION RULES ENGINE** (`src/notifications/rules.rs`)

**Rule Types & Triggers**:
| Type | Trigger | Matches On |
|------|---------|-----------|
| keyword | Every event | Payload/event_type contains keywords (any/all mode) |
| topic | Every event | event_type matches glob pattern (e.g., "ops.trip.*") or prefix list |
| entity_threshold | Bus poll (5s) | Metric crosses operator+threshold (open_conflicts, unassigned_trips, active_trips) |
| spike | Bus poll (5s) | Metric change > threshold_pct in window vs previous |

**Config Schemas** (validated on create/update):
```
keyword: { "keywords": ["str", ...], "match_mode": "any"|"all" }
topic: { "pattern": "ops.trip.*" } OR { "topics": ["ops.trip", "ops.request"] }
entity_threshold: { "metric": "open_conflicts"|"unassigned_trips"|"active_trips", 
                    "threshold": <int>, "operator": ">"|">="|"=="|"<="|"<", 
                    "entity_id": "<uuid>" (optional) }
spike: { "metric": "conflict_rate"|"cancellation_rate"|"driver_assignment_rate",
         "threshold_pct": <float>, "window_minutes": <int (default 10)>,
         "direction": "up"|"down"|"either" }
```

**Key Functions**:
- `validate_rule_config(rule_type, config)` — Validates schema
- `evaluate_event_rules(pool, events)` — Runs keyword/topic rules against event batch
- `evaluate_periodic_rules(pool)` — Runs threshold/spike rules
- `fire_rule(pool, rule, description)` — Creates `sys.rule_alert` event + delivery, respects DND, updates cooldown
- `is_in_cooldown(rule)` — Checks if `now() - last_triggered_at < cooldown_minutes`

**Rule Alert Creation**:
- Creates `sys.rule_alert` event with `processed_at = now()` (so bus never fans it out)
- Payload: `{ rule_id, rule_name, rule_type, description, severity }`
- Delivery created directly (queued or delivered based on DND)

1	/// Event fan-out bus.
2	///
3	/// Poll loop (every 5 s):
4	///   1. process_pending_events  — fan-out to subscribers + evaluate keyword/topic rules
5	///   2. evaluate_periodic_rules — threshold and spike rules (poll-based)
6	///   3. flush_dnd_queue         — promote 'queued' deliveries when DND ends
7	///
8	/// DND handling
9	/// ─────────────
10	///   Non-critical deliveries for users in a DND window are inserted with
11	///   status = 'queued'. `flush_dnd_queue` promotes them to 'delivered' when
12	///   the window closes. Critical-severity events (and critical rule alerts)
13	///   bypass DND and are delivered immediately.
14	///
15	/// Deduplication
16	/// ─────────────
17	///   Before inserting a delivery the bus checks whether the same
18	///   (user, event_type, source_entity_id) was delivered or queued within the
19	///   last 15 minutes. If so, the delivery is skipped. The UNIQUE constraint
20	///   on (event_id, user_id) provides a safety net against concurrent inserts.
21	use chrono::{NaiveTime, Utc};
22	use serde_json::Value;
23	use sqlx::PgPool;
24	use std::time::Duration;
25	use uuid::Uuid;
26	
27	use crate::notifications::{models::PendingEventRow, rules};
28	
29	// ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30	
31	/// Spawn once in `main()`. Runs forever.
32	pub async fn run_event_bus(pool: PgPool) {
33	    let interval = Duration::from_secs(5);
34	    loop {
35	        // 1. Fan-out pending events
36	        match process_pending_events(&pool).await {
37	            Ok(n) if n > 0 => tracing::info!(count = n, "Event bus: fan-out complete"),
38	            Ok(_)          => {}
39	            Err(e)         => tracing::error!("Event bus [process]: {}", e),
40	        }
41	
42	        // 2. Threshold / spike rules (poll-based)
43	        if let Err(e) = rules::evaluate_periodic_rules(&pool).await {
44	            tracing::error!("Event bus [periodic rules]: {}", e);
45	        }
46	
47	        // 3. Promote queued deliveries for users whose DND window ended
48	        if let Err(e) = flush_dnd_queue(&pool).await {
49	            tracing::error!("Event bus [dnd flush]: {}", e);
50	        }
51	
52	        tokio::time::sleep(interval).await;
53	    }
54	}
55	
56	/// Fan-out one batch (≤ 50) of unprocessed events.
57	/// Also evaluates keyword/topic rules across the batch.
58	/// Returns the number of events processed.
59	pub async fn process_pending_events(pool: &PgPool) -> Result<usize, sqlx::Error> {
60	    let events = sqlx::query_as::<_, PendingEventRow>(
61	        r#"
62	        SELECT e.id,
63	               e.event_type,
64	               e.source_entity_id,
65	               e.actor_id,
66	               e.payload,
67	               COALESCE(
68	                   NULLIF(e.payload->>'severity', ''),
69	                   ed.severity,
70	                   'info'
71	               ) AS effective_severity
72	        FROM   notifications.events e
73	        JOIN   notifications.event_definitions ed ON ed.event_type = e.event_type
74	        WHERE  e.processed_at IS NULL
75	        ORDER  BY e.created_at ASC
76	        LIMIT  50
77	        "#,
78	    )
79	    .fetch_all(pool)
80	    .await?;
81	
82	    let count = events.len();
83	
84	    for event in &events {
85	        if let Err(e) = fan_out_event(pool, event).await {
86	            tracing::error!(
87	                event_id   = %event.id,
88	                event_type = %event.event_type,
89	                "Fan-out failed — will retry: {}",
90	                e
91	            );
92	            continue; // leave processed_at NULL so it retries next poll
93	        }
94	
95	        sqlx::query(
96	            "UPDATE notifications.events SET processed_at = now() WHERE id = $1",
97	        )
98	        .bind(event.id)
99	        .execute(pool)
100	        .await?;
101	    }
102	
103	    // Keyword/topic rule evaluation — once for the whole batch (one rule load)
104	    if let Err(e) = rules::evaluate_event_rules(pool, &events).await {
105	        tracing::error!("Event rule evaluation failed: {}", e);
106	    }
107	
108	    Ok(count)
109	}
110	
111	// ── DND check — pub(crate) so rules.rs can use it ────────────────────────────
112	
113	/// Returns `true` if the user's DND window is currently active (UTC).
114	/// Returns `false` for unknown users (no preferences row).
115	pub(crate) async fn check_dnd(pool: &PgPool, user_id: Uuid) -> Result<bool, sqlx::Error> {
116	    #[derive(sqlx::FromRow)]
117	    struct PrefRow {
118	        dnd_enabled: bool,
119	        dnd_start:   Option<NaiveTime>,
120	        dnd_end:     Option<NaiveTime>,
121	    }
122	
123	    let pref = sqlx::query_as::<_, PrefRow>(
124	        "SELECT dnd_enabled, dnd_start, dnd_end \
125	         FROM   notifications.preferences \
126	         WHERE  user_id = $1",
127	    )
128	    .bind(user_id)
129	    .fetch_optional(pool)
130	    .await?;
131	
132	    Ok(match pref {
133	        None                          => false,
134	        Some(p) if !p.dnd_enabled     => false,
135	        Some(PrefRow { dnd_start: Some(start), dnd_end: Some(end), .. }) => {
136	            let now = Utc::now().naive_utc().time();
137	            if start <= end {
138	                now >= start && now <= end   // e.g. 08:00–18:00
139	            } else {
140	                now >= start || now <= end   // crosses midnight e.g. 22:00–07:00
141	            }
142	        }
143	        _ => true, // dnd_enabled with no time window → all-day DND
144	    })
145	}
146	
147	// ── Fan-out ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
148	
149	async fn fan_out_event(pool: &PgPool, event: &PendingEventRow) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
150	    let severity  = event.effective_severity.as_str();
151	    let recipients = get_recipients(pool, event).await?;
152	
153	    for user_id in recipients {
154	        // Never notify the user who triggered the event
155	        if event.actor_id == Some(user_id) {
156	            continue;
157	        }
158	
159	        // Deduplication: skip if same (user, event_type, entity) delivered/queued within 15 min
160	        if check_duplicate(pool, user_id, &event.event_type, event.source_entity_id).await? {
161	            tracing::debug!(
162	                %user_id,
163	                event_type = %event.event_type,
164	                "Delivery suppressed: 15-min dedup window"
165	            );
166	            continue;
167	        }
168	
169	        if severity != "critical" && check_dnd(pool, user_id).await? {
170	            // Queue for delivery when DND ends instead of discarding
171	            sqlx::query(
172	                "INSERT INTO notifications.deliveries (event_id, user_id, status) \
173	                 VALUES ($1, $2, 'queued') \
174	                 ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id) DO NOTHING",
175	            )
176	            .bind(event.id)
177	            .bind(user_id)
178	            .execute(pool)
179	            .await?;
180	        } else {
181	            // Deliver immediately
182	            sqlx::query(
183	                "INSERT INTO notifications.deliveries \
184	                     (event_id, user_id, status, delivered_at) \
185	                 VALUES ($1, $2, 'delivered', now()) \
186	                 ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id) DO NOTHING",
187	            )
188	            .bind(event.id)
189	            .bind(user_id)
190	            .execute(pool)
191	            .await?;
192	        }
193	    }
194	
195	    Ok(())
196	}
197	
198	async fn get_recipients(pool: &PgPool, event: &PendingEventRow) -> Result<Vec<Uuid>, sqlx::Error> {
199	    if event.event_type == "sys.announcement" {
200	        let target_roles: Option<Vec<String>> = event
201	            .payload
202	            .get("target_roles")
203	            .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
204	            .map(|arr| {
205	                arr.iter()
206	                    .filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from))
207	                    .collect()
208	            });
209	
210	        let is_all = target_roles
211	            .as_deref()
212	            .map_or(true, |r| r.is_empty() || r == ["all"]);
213	
214	        if is_all {
215	            sqlx::query_scalar(
216	                "SELECT id FROM auth.users WHERE is_active = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL",
217	            )
218	            .fetch_all(pool)
219	            .await
220	        } else {
221	            let roles = target_roles.unwrap();
222	            sqlx::query_scalar(
223	                "SELECT u.id FROM auth.users u \
224	                 JOIN   auth.roles r ON r.id = u.role_id \
225	                 WHERE  u.is_active = TRUE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL \
226	                   AND  r.name = ANY($1)",
227	            )
228	            .bind(&roles)
229	            .fetch_all(pool)
230	            .await
231	        }
232	    } else {
233	        sqlx::query_scalar(
234	            "SELECT user_id FROM notifications.subscriptions WHERE event_type = $1",
235	        )
236	        .bind(&event.event_type)
237	        .fetch_all(pool)
238	        .await
239	    }
240	}
241	
242	/// Returns `true` if a non-dismissed delivery for the same
243	/// (user, event_type, source_entity_id) exists within the last 15 minutes.
244	async fn check_duplicate(
245	    pool:             &PgPool,
246	    user_id:          Uuid,
247	    event_type:       &str,
248	    source_entity_id: Option<Uuid>,
249	) -> Result<bool, sqlx::Error> {
250	    sqlx::query_scalar(
251	        r#"
252	        SELECT EXISTS (
253	            SELECT 1
254	            FROM   notifications.deliveries d
255	            JOIN   notifications.events     e ON e.id = d.event_id
256	            WHERE  d.user_id         = $1
257	              AND  e.event_type      = $2
258	              AND  (
259	                    ($3::UUID IS NULL AND e.source_entity_id IS NULL)
260	                 OR  e.source_entity_id = $3
261	              )
262	              AND  d.created_at      > now() - interval '15 minutes'
263	              AND  d.status         != 'dismissed'
264	        )
265	        "#,
266	    )
267	    .bind(user_id)
268	    .bind(event_type)
269	    .bind(source_entity_id)
270	    .fetch_one(pool)
271	    .await
272	}
273	
274	// ── DND queue flush ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
275	
276	/// Promote 'queued' deliveries to 'delivered' for every user whose DND window
277	/// is not currently active. Uses a single UPDATE to minimise round-trips.
278	///
279	/// DND-inactive conditions:
280	///   • No preferences row (no DND configured)
281	///   • dnd_enabled = FALSE
282	///   • dnd_enabled = TRUE with a time window, but that window is not currently open
283	///
284	/// All-day DND (dnd_enabled = TRUE, both times NULL) keeps deliveries queued.
285	async fn flush_dnd_queue(pool: &PgPool) -> Result<u64, sqlx::Error> {
286	    let rows = sqlx::query(
287	        r#"
288	        UPDATE notifications.deliveries
289	        SET    status       = 'delivered',
290	               delivered_at = now()
291	        WHERE  status = 'queued'
292	          AND  user_id IN (
293	              SELECT u.id
294	              FROM   auth.users u
295	              LEFT   JOIN notifications.preferences p ON p.user_id = u.id
296	              WHERE  u.is_active   = TRUE
297	                AND  u.deleted_at  IS NULL
298	                AND  (
299	                    -- No preferences row → no DND configured
300	                    p.user_id IS NULL
301	
302	                    -- DND explicitly disabled
303	                    OR p.dnd_enabled = FALSE
304	
305	                    -- DND with a time window that is NOT currently active
306	                    OR (
307	                        p.dnd_enabled = TRUE
308	                        AND p.dnd_start IS NOT NULL
309	                        AND p.dnd_end   IS NOT NULL
310	                        AND NOT (
311	                            CASE
312	                                WHEN p.dnd_start <= p.dnd_end THEN
313	                                    now()::TIME BETWEEN p.dnd_start AND p.dnd_end
314	                                ELSE
315	                                    -- crosses midnight
316	                                    now()::TIME >= p.dnd_start
317	                                    OR now()::TIME <= p.dnd_end
318	                            END
319	                        )
320	                    )
321	                )
322	          )
323	        "#,
324	    )
325	    .execute(pool)
326	    .await?
327	    .rows_affected();
328	
329	    if rows > 0 {
330	        tracing::info!(count = rows, "DND flush: promoted queued deliveries");
331	    }
332	
333	    Ok(rows)
334	}

-- Migration 012 — Pluggable notification channel infrastructure
-- ============================================================
--
-- Adds two tables that support external channel delivery
-- (email, SMS, WeCom) alongside the existing in-app inbox:
--
--   channel_preferences  — per-user opt-in per channel with
--                          the delivery address (email addr,
--                          phone number, WeCom user ID).
--
--   channel_deliveries   — records each external dispatch
--                          attempt with outcome for audit /
--                          retry visibility.
--
-- Channels are DISABLED by default.  A user must explicitly
-- call PUT /notifications/channels/{channel} to opt in.
-- An adapter only activates when its connector URL env var is
-- set; without it, is_available() returns false and no
-- network calls are made.
-- ============================================================

-- ---- Per-user channel preferences ----
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications.channel_preferences (
    user_id          UUID        NOT NULL
                     REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    channel          VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
                     CHECK (channel IN ('email', 'sms', 'wecom')),
    enabled          BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    -- The address at which this user wants to receive messages
    -- on this channel: email address | E.164 phone | WeCom user_id
    channel_address  TEXT        NOT NULL
                     CHECK (char_length(trim(channel_address)) > 0),
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, channel)
);

-- ---- External dispatch tracking ----
-- UNIQUE (event_id, user_id, channel) prevents duplicate dispatch
-- on bus retries; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is used in the bus.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications.channel_deliveries (
    id           UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    event_id     UUID        NOT NULL
                 REFERENCES notifications.events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id      UUID        NOT NULL
                 REFERENCES auth.users(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
    channel      VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent'
                 CHECK (status IN ('sent', 'failed', 'skipped')),
    error_msg    TEXT,
    attempted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (event_id, user_id, channel)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_channel_deliveries_event
    ON notifications.channel_deliveries (event_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_channel_deliveries_failed
    ON notifications.channel_deliveries (attempted_at DESC)
    WHERE status = 'failed';
"}

5. Problem Solving:

- **Audit write-path immutability**: Used DB-level GRANT (already in schema.sql: `GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON audit.audit_logs TO transitops_app`). The Rust code never issues UPDATE/DELETE against the audit table; enforced by code structure (all writes through `append()` which only does INSERT).

- **Key rotation support**: `FieldEncryptor::with_previous_key()` registers a fallback cipher. `decrypt_bytes()` tries current key first, then previous. `encrypt_bytes()` always uses current. No per-row version tracking needed for basic rotation.

- **Adapter object safety**: `Box<dyn NotificationAdapter>` requires object-safe async methods. Used `#[async_trait::async_trait]` macro which rewrites `async fn` to `Pin<Box<dyn Future + Send>>` return type.

- **Registry thread safety**: `AdapterRegistry` wraps `Arc<Vec<Box<dyn NotificationAdapter>>>`. Each concrete adapter holds `reqwest::Client` which is `Clone + Send + Sync`. `Aes256Gcm` is `Clone + Send + Sync`.

- **Non-fatal channel failures**: `dispatch_channels()` is `async` and returns `()`. All errors are logged via `tracing::warn!` and recorded in `channel_deliveries`. The outer `fan_out_event` is not affected by channel failures.

- **DND + channel consistency**: External channel dispatch only occurs on the immediate-delivery path (not the DND-queue path). This ensures users in DND don't receive external notifications while their inbox delivery is queued.

157	/// POST /payments/callbacks/{gateway}
158	///
159	/// Receives an inbound webhook from a payment provider.
160	/// Pipeline:
161	///   1. Extract signature, nonce, timestamp from headers (per gateway config).
162	///   2. Verify signature + anti-replay (timestamp window + nonce uniqueness).
163	///   3. Insert callback record.
164	///   4. Attempt to match against a pending transaction and update its status.
165	pub async fn receive_callback(
166	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
167	    req:     HttpRequest,
168	    path:    web::Path<String>,
169	    body:    web::Bytes,
170	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
171	    let gateway_name = path.into_inner();
172	    let gw = load_gateway(&state.db, &gateway_name).await
173	        .map_err(AppError::from)?;
174	
175	    // ---- Extract anti-replay headers ----
176	    let get_header = |name: &str| -> Result<String, AppError> {
177	        req.headers()
178	            .get(name)
179	            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
180	            .map(str::to_string)
181	            .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest(
182	                format!("Missing required header: {}", name)
183	            ))
184	    };
185	
186	    let signature  = get_header(gw.sig_header())?;
187	    let nonce      = get_header(gw.nonce_header())?;
188	    let ts_str     = get_header(gw.ts_header())?;
189	    let timestamp: i64 = ts_str.parse().map_err(|_|
190	        AppError::BadRequest("Invalid timestamp header (expected integer seconds)".to_string())
191	    )?;
192	
193	    // ---- Verify signature + anti-replay ----
194	    verify_callback(&state.db, &gw, &body, &nonce, timestamp, &signature)
195	        .await
196	        .map_err(AppError::from)?;
197	
198	    // ---- Parse payload (best-effort; store raw bytes even if unparseable) ----
199	    let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&body).unwrap_or(
200	        serde_json::json!({ "_raw": hex::encode(&body) })
201	    );
202	    let payload_hash = sig_sha256_hex(&body);
203	    let callback_ts: DateTime<Utc> = chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp(timestamp, 0)
204	        .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
205	
206	    // ---- Match against an existing transaction ----
207	    let txn_ref      = payload.get("transaction_ref")
208	        .or_else(|| payload.get("out_trade_no"))
209	        .or_else(|| payload.get("transaction_id"))
210	        .and_then(|v| v.as_str());
211	
212	    let transaction_id: Option<Uuid> = if let Some(ref_val) = txn_ref {
213	        sqlx::query_scalar!(
214	            "SELECT id FROM payments.transactions WHERE idempotency_key = $1 LIMIT 1",
215	            ref_val,
216	        )
217	        .fetch_optional(&state.db)
218	        .await
219	        .ok()
220	        .flatten()
221	    } else {
222	        None
223	    };
224	
225	    // ---- Insert callback record ----
226	    let callback_id = sqlx::query_scalar!(
227	        r#"
228	        INSERT INTO payments.callbacks
229	            (transaction_id, nonce, signature, payload_hash,
230	             payload, source, callback_timestamp, status)
231	        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'received')
232	        RETURNING id
233	        "#,
234	        transaction_id,
235	        nonce,
236	        signature,
237	        payload_hash,
238	        payload,
239	        gateway_name,
240	        callback_ts,
241	    )
242	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
243	    .await?;
244	
245	    // ---- Promote transaction status based on callback ----
246	    if let Some(tx_id) = transaction_id {
247	        let cb_status = payload.get("status")
248	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
249	            .unwrap_or("");
250	
251	        let new_tx_status = if cb_status.to_uppercase().starts_with("FAIL") {
252	            "failed"
253	        } else if cb_status.to_uppercase().starts_with("SUCCESS")
254	               || cb_status.to_uppercase() == "PAID"
255	               || cb_status.to_uppercase() == "COMPLETED" {
256	            "completed"
257	        } else {
258	            // Unknown status — leave transaction unchanged
259	            ""
260	        };
261	
262	        if !new_tx_status.is_empty() {
263	            sqlx::query!(
264	                r#"UPDATE payments.transactions
265	                   SET status = $2, updated_at = now()
266	                   WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'"#,
267	                tx_id,
268	                new_tx_status,
269	            )
270	            .execute(&state.db)
271	            .await?;
272	        }
273	
274	        // Mark callback processed
275	        sqlx::query!(
276	            r#"UPDATE payments.callbacks
277	               SET status = 'processed', processed_at = now()
278	               WHERE id = $1"#,
279	            callback_id,
280	        )
281	        .execute(&state.db)
282	        .await?;
283	    }
284	
285	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(serde_json::json!({
286	        "callback_id": callback_id,
287	        "status":      "received",
288	    })))
289	}

291	/// POST /payments/callbacks/simulate
292	///
293	/// Simulates a gateway callback for a given transaction — useful in development
294	/// and integration testing.  Skips signature verification.
295	pub async fn simulate_callback(
296	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
297	    session: AuthSession,
298	    body:    web::Json<SimulateCallbackRequest>,
299	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
300	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsTransactionsWrite)?;
301	
302	    // Verify transaction exists
303	    let _ = sqlx::query_scalar!(
304	        "SELECT id FROM payments.transactions WHERE id = $1",
305	        body.transaction_id,
306	    )
307	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
308	    .await?
309	    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Transaction not found".to_string()))?;
310	
311	    let valid_statuses = ["completed", "failed"];
312	    if !valid_statuses.contains(&body.status.as_str()) {
313	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
314	            "status must be 'completed' or 'failed'".to_string(),
315	        ));
316	    }
317	
318	    let now       = Utc::now();
319	    let nonce     = format!("sim_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());
320	    let payload   = serde_json::json!({
321	        "status":          body.status,
322	        "transaction_ref": body.transaction_id,
323	        "amount":          body.amount_cents,
324	        "simulated":       true,
325	    });
326	    let payload_hash = sig_sha256_hex(payload.to_string().as_bytes());
327	
328	    let callback_id = sqlx::query_scalar!(
329	        r#"
330	        INSERT INTO payments.callbacks
331	            (transaction_id, nonce, signature, payload_hash,
332	             payload, source, callback_timestamp, status, processed_at)
333	        VALUES ($1, $2, 'SIMULATED', $3, $4, $5, $6, 'processed', now())
334	        RETURNING id
335	        "#,
336	        body.transaction_id,
337	        nonce,
338	        payload_hash,
339	        payload,
340	        body.gateway,
341	        now,
342	    )
343	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
344	    .await?;
345	
346	    // Update transaction status
347	    let new_status = &body.status;
348	    sqlx::query!(
349	        r#"UPDATE payments.transactions
350	           SET status = $2, updated_at = now()
351	           WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'"#,
352	        body.transaction_id,
353	        new_status,
354	    )
355	    .execute(&state.db)
356	    .await?;
357	
358	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(serde_json::json!({
359	        "callback_id":    callback_id,
360	        "transaction_id": body.transaction_id,
361	        "status":         "processed",
362	    })))
363	}

395	/// POST /payments/imports
396	///
397	/// Upload a payment result file (base64-encoded in JSON body).
398	/// SHA-256 of file content prevents duplicate ingestion.
399	pub async fn upload_import(
400	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
401	    session: AuthSession,
402	    body:    web::Json<UploadImportRequest>,
403	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
404	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsStatementsImport)?;
405	
406	    let valid_formats = ["csv", "json"];
407	    if !valid_formats.contains(&body.format.as_str()) {
408	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
409	            "format must be 'csv' or 'json'".to_string(),
410	        ));
411	    }
412	
413	    // Decode base64 content
414	    let content = B64.decode(&body.content_base64).map_err(|e| {
415	        AppError::BadRequest(format!("content_base64 is not valid base64: {}", e))
416	    })?;
417	
418	    let file_hash    = sha256_hex(&content);
419	    let import_date  = Utc::now().date_naive();
420	
421	    // Duplicate detection — same file hash
422	    let existing = sqlx::query_scalar!(
423	        "SELECT id FROM payments.statement_imports WHERE file_hash = $1",
424	        file_hash,
425	    )
426	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
427	    .await?;
428	
429	    if let Some(existing_id) = existing {
430	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
431	            "File already imported (import_id: {})", existing_id
432	        )));
433	    }
434	
435	    let row = sqlx::query_as!(
436	        StatementImportRow,
437	        r#"
438	        INSERT INTO payments.statement_imports
439	            (filename, file_hash, source, import_date, imported_by, raw_content_encrypted)
440	        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
441	        RETURNING id, filename, file_hash, source, import_date,
442	                  status, total_records, processed_records,
443	                  error_count, imported_by, created_at, updated_at
444	        "#,
445	        body.filename,
446	        file_hash,
447	        body.source,
448	        import_date,
449	        session.user_id,
450	        content.as_slice(),   // stored as raw bytes in raw_content_encrypted BYTEA
451	    )
452	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
453	    .await?;
454	
455	    Ok(HttpResponse::Created().json(StatementImportResponse::from(row)))
456	}

509	/// POST /payments/imports/{id}/process
510	///
511	/// Parses the stored file content and matches lines against transactions.
512	/// Idempotent: re-running on a completed import does nothing and returns the
513	/// current state.
514	pub async fn process_import(
515	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
516	    session: AuthSession,
517	    path:    web::Path<Uuid>,
518	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
519	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsStatementsImport)?;
520	    let id = *path;
521	
522	    // Load the import row
523	    let row = sqlx::query!(
524	        "SELECT status, raw_content_encrypted FROM payments.statement_imports WHERE id = $1",
525	        id,
526	    )
527	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
528	    .await?
529	    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Import not found".to_string()))?;
530	
531	    if row.status == "completed" {
532	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(
533	            "Import already processed".to_string(),
534	        ));
535	    }
536	
537	    let content = row.raw_content_encrypted.ok_or_else(|| {
538	        AppError::BadRequest("Import has no stored content".to_string())
539	    })?;
540	
541	    // Detect format from existing metadata (we store filename)
542	    let import_row = sqlx::query_as!(
543	        StatementImportRow,
544	        r#"
545	        SELECT id, filename, file_hash, source, import_date,
546	               status, total_records, processed_records,
547	               error_count, imported_by, created_at, updated_at
548	        FROM payments.statement_imports WHERE id = $1
549	        "#,
550	        id,
551	    )
552	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
553	    .await?;
554	
555	    let format = if import_row.filename.ends_with(".json") { "json" } else { "csv" };
556	
557	    // Mark as 'processing'
558	    sqlx::query!(
559	        "UPDATE payments.statement_imports SET status = 'processing', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1",
560	        id,
561	    )
562	    .execute(&state.db)
563	    .await?;
564	
565	    let (total, matched) = process_import_file(&state.db, id, format, &content).await?;
566	
567	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(serde_json::json!({
568	        "import_id":      id,
569	        "total_records":  total,
570	        "matched":        matched,
571	        "unmatched":      total - matched,
572	        "status":         "completed",
573	    })))
574	}

753	/// is a synchronous state machine for offline operation.
754	pub async fn process_refund(
755	    state:   web::Data<AppState>,
756	    session: AuthSession,
757	    path:    web::Path<Uuid>,
758	) -> Result<HttpResponse, AppError> {
759	    session.require(Permission::PaymentsRefundsApprove)?;
760	    let id = *path;
761	
762	    let existing = sqlx::query!(
763	        "SELECT status, transaction_id, amount::double precision FROM payments.refunds WHERE id = $1",
764	        id,
765	    )
766	    .fetch_optional(&state.db)
767	    .await?
768	    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest("Refund not found".to_string()))?;
769	
770	    if existing.status != "approved" {
771	        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(format!(
772	            "Refund cannot be processed from status '{}' (must be approved)", existing.status
773	        )));
774	    }
775	
776	    // Process: mark 'completed' and update the parent transaction
777	    let row = sqlx::query_as!(
778	        RefundRow,
779	        r#"
780	        UPDATE payments.refunds
781	        SET status = 'completed', processed_at = now(), updated_at = now()
782	        WHERE id = $1
783	        RETURNING id, transaction_id, idempotency_key, amount::double precision, reason,
784	                  status, requested_by, approved_by, processed_at,

786	        "#,

789	    .fetch_one(&state.db)
790	    .await?;

792	    // Update parent transaction status

794	    // otherwise → 'partially_refunded'
795	    sqlx::query!(
796	        r#"
797	        UPDATE payments.transactions
798	        SET status = CASE
799	            WHEN $2 >= amount THEN 'refunded'
800	            ELSE 'partially_refunded'
801	        END,
802	        updated_at = now()
803	        WHERE id = $1
804	        "#,
805	        existing.transaction_id,
806	        existing.amount,
807	    )
808	    .execute(&state.db)
809	    .await?;
810	
811	    Ok(HttpResponse::Ok().json(RefundResponse::from(row)))
812	}
